title: Order counts and complete records
scenario: Velora Office Supply is reconciling 26 fictitious customer orders. Every order has a text order code, a shipment reference, a units count and a value in Canadian dollars. A complete order register should count records without mistaking text codes for numbers.

lesson.intro: Counting answers a different question from totaling. Clean text identifiers are valid data: a code such as VO-501 is not a number and should not be coerced into one.

functions.name: COUNT
functions.purpose: Count numeric cells in a referenced range.
functions.arguments: value1 is the first range or input; optional values add further ranges or inputs.
functions.useCase: Count numeric quantity or test-result entries.
functions.mistake: Text identifiers in a referenced range do not count; zero does.

functions.name: COUNTA
functions.purpose: Count cells that are not empty.
functions.arguments: value1 is a range or value; optional arguments add more inputs.
functions.useCase: Count populated order IDs or shipment references.
functions.mistake: A formula returning empty text is still counted; COUNTA is not a unique-record counter.

lesson.combine: Reuse SUM to compute total order value. Dividing that total by COUNTA of order IDs gives value per recorded order. Relative references move when copied: Data!D2 becomes Data!D3 one row down. Count only data rows, because COUNTA would include a text header.

tasks.prompt: Count numeric entries in the Units column. Do not total the units.
Count populated Order_code cells, excluding the heading.
Count numeric entries in Order_code. The task concerns the stored cell type, not the digits inside each text code.
Calculate value per recorded order: total Order_value_CAD divided by the count of populated Order_code cells. Submit the unrounded number.

bonus.prompt: Calculate average units per recorded shipment using total units and the count of Shipment_ref entries.

columns.name: Shipment_ref
columns.description: Invented dispatch reference; every row is populated.
